title: Rav Chiyya son of Rav Yeiva
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Sukkah 42b, adding to Rav Chisda’s words and saying, “And an adult, even though he is not able — as it is written, ‘He who increases knowledge,’” etc. Hyman reports that the Rif reads Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba and that Dikdukei Soferim reads “son of Ravina.”

notes.text: The consulted Sukkah passage gives Rav Chiyya son of Rav Yeiva. The two alternate readings are Hyman’s reports of the Rif and Dikdukei Soferim.
